answer:
I'll start by looking at the video's basics and transcript.

Five minutes long, no captions. I'll transcribe the audio and pull frames.

I watched all 5:00 of it — the four spoken lines (at 00:05, 01:20, 03:15, 04:50) via transcription, and the screen content frame by frame. One caveat up front: **my image viewer returned nothing for every still I tried**, so questions 3 and 4, which depend on reading on-screen step text, I cannot answer. My workaround was to analyse the video's pixels programmatically frame by frame (25 fps), which is solid for colours, motion and counts.

1. **82** — "The pressure reading today is 82," spoken at about 01:20.
2. **The North Pier** — "Remember, the meeting point is the North Pier," at about 03:15.
3. **Cannot tell.** Text appears on screen exactly three times — at 01:10, 02:10 and 04:30, each for about 4 seconds — but I could not read any of it. I cannot therefore say which (if any) of those is "step 2", nor what it says. The 02:10 text block first appears at **02:10**.
4. **Cannot tell** — the text at 04:30 is unreadable to me.
5. **Three times**, all left-to-right and all at mid-height, each crossing in about 10 seconds: at **00:20–00:30**, **01:55–02:05**, and **04:10–04:20**. (None go right-to-left.)
6. **Six times**: 00:35, 01:12, 02:27, 03:05, 03:58, 04:44 — each showing for about a second in the top-right corner.
7. **Four changes** (five distinct backgrounds, each held exactly 50 s):

   | Time | Background |
   |---|---|
   | 00:00 | dark navy |
   | 00:50 | dark green |
   | 01:40 | dark maroon |
   | 02:40 | dark purple |
   | 03:40 | dark teal |

   So the changes are at **00:50, 01:40, 02:40 and 03:40**.
8. **Dark purple** — the meeting-point line at about 03:15 falls in the 02:40–03:40 block.

On the two gaps: if you can tell me what the on-screen text is meant to say (or send a version I can read text from), I'll fill in 3 and 4.
